headline: Junior Web Developer
summary: Junior web developer with a year of full-time work building React interfaces for a cooperative's member portal in Kalinga. I handle both the screens members see and the MySQL queries behind their statements, and I test my changes before they reach the office staff. I want to grow into a full-stack role on a product team.

skill_groups.label: Workflow
items: clear written updates for non-technical users

experience.title: Junior Web Developer
bullets: Built React components for a loan and share-capital portal used by about 1,200 members across Kalinga.
Wrote SQL queries and MySQL views for monthly member statements, cutting report preparation from two days to one afternoon.
Added Jest unit tests to the payment-schedule module and caught a centavo rounding error before it reached members.
Reviewed teammates' pull requests on GitHub and wrote short release notes the office staff could follow.

experience.title: Web Development Intern
bullets: Turned printed festival schedules for the provincial Ullalim season into responsive HTML and CSS pages that worked on low-end phones.

projects.name: Palengke Price Watch
projects.description: A site where vendors in the Tabuk public market post daily prices of rice, vegetables and fish so buyers can compare before travelling to town.
bullets: Built the price board and vendor sign-in screens in React.
Designed the MySQL tables and the SQL that averages prices by week.
Ran two rounds of hands-on trials with twelve vendors and fixed the confusing parts of the form.

projects.name: Barangay Clearance Queue
projects.description: A JavaScript page that gives residents a queue number and an estimated waiting time at the barangay hall, backed by a small MySQL table.

projects.name: Personal portfolio
projects.description: Hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript site listing my projects, versioned on GitHub.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
